cross_check.result: No distinct defect observed in selected utility implementations. Sentry initialization remains wired in main.py behind SENTRY_DSN despite repository policy marking Sentry dead; code-level privacy options exist. This is policy/configuration drift only, not evidence that Sentry is enabled in production.

no_new_issue_observed: Selected parsers and pure helpers have direct tests; those tests were read, not executed.
Sentry code sets send_default_pii=False, include_local_variables=False, and max_request_body_size="never"; environment and runtime activation were not checked.

not_done: No runtime environment variables, Sentry project, network, production logs or user data were accessed.
Phone helper test coverage and callers beyond the selected test remain open.
This slice does not constitute a review of all core modules or the full source tree.
